metadata.body:
# PoroTomo Induced-Seismicity Agent

Blueprint for clio-agent. The numeric work lives in plain scripts in this
repository so it can run on PBS compute nodes without an LLM:

- `agent/manifest.py`: list the DASV records on `s3://nrel-pds-porotomo/` and sample them.
- `agent/detect.py`: per-record detector (common-mode removal, 10-150 Hz band-pass, median STA/LTA).
- `agent/pbs/submit.sh`: submit the distributed detection plus aggregation job to Aurora.
- `agent/hazard.py`: anomaly z-scores, event catalogue, pumping volumes, seismogenic index, probabilities.

The experts orchestrate those scripts, inspect files, and explain results. They
never make up numbers. Every figure they report comes from `summary.json` or a
tool result.

Install by linking this directory into `~/.config/clio-agent/agent-blueprints/`.

agent_blueprint.name: PoroTomo Induced-Seismicity Agent

session.title: porotomo-induced-seismicity: Report the headline results of the agent

answer:
Headline results of the agent run /home/hyoklee/poro/agent/results/run_20261115T155359Z_s20 (run id run_20261115T155359Z_s20; summary.json generated 2026-11-15T16:02:33+00:00; associated PBS job 9092130.aurora-pbs-0001.hostmgmt.cm.aurora.alcf.anl.gov). Read-only inspection: no PBS jobs submitted, hazard.py not run, nothing written to the run directory.

RECORDS ANALYSED
- 759 records analysed, all with status "ok" (records_by_status {"ok": 759}).
- First pass had 753 ok + 6 download_failed (curl SSL EOF); the 6 were retried successfully, giving the final 759.
- Data window: 2016-03-18T02:09:17Z to 2016-03-26T00:59:44Z, stride 20.

ANOMALIES AND DAS DETECTIONS
- 57 anomalous records (z_threshold = 5.0).
- 62 DAS detections (n_das_events = 62).

SEISMOGENIC INDEX Sigma (catalogue-based, from summary.json sigma_catalog_based)
- b = 1.0: Sigma = -5.448901270028832
- b = 0.73: Sigma = -5.3193012700288325
- b = 0.65: Sigma = -5.280901270028833
- DAS-based upper bound: Sigma = -2.698279919032152 (sigma_das_upper_bound)

P(Mw >= 5.5) PER YEAR at the observed rate (summary.json p_mw55_per_year_at_observed_rate)
- b = 1.0: 0.00011982478978644906 (~1.20e-4 /yr)
- b = 0.73: 0.004921548824626587 (~4.92e-3 /yr)
- b = 0.65: 0.014735103451029574 (~1.47e-2 /yr)
- DAS-based upper bound: 0.07842182774171746 (~7.84e-2 /yr) — flagged in summary.json as "das_upper_bound_overcounts_uncalibrated"

CALIBRATED vs UPPER BOUND
- CALIBRATED: the hazard_catalog_based estimate — P(Mw>=5.5) per year computed from the LBNL/NCEDC March 2016 catalogue (GDR 859), i.e. the b-scenario values above. This is the calibrated probability.
- UPPER BOUND: the DAS-based value (0.07842182774171746 /yr, Sigma = -2.698279919032152). Per summary.json it treats every DAS detection as an event at/above the catalogue minimum magnitude, so it over-counts, and its magnitudes are uncalibrated relative magnitudes — hence a DAS-based upper bound with uncalibrated magnitudes, not a calibrated probability.

ASSUMPTIONS each rests on (as stated in summary.json): the catalogue-based numbers assume the LBNL/NCEDC March 2016 catalogue (GDR 859) Gutenberg-Richter rates with the stated b values; the DAS upper bound assumes every one of the 62 DAS detections counts as an event at/above catalogue minimum magnitude with uncalibrated relative magnitudes, so it is an over-counting upper bound only. Anomaly flagging assumes z_threshold = 5.0 over the 759-record window 2016-03-18T02:09:17Z to 2016-03-26T00:59:44Z (stride 20).

All figures are quoted exactly as summary.json gives them; evidence source: /home/hyoklee/poro/agent/results/run_20261115T155359Z_s20/summary.json (plus anomalies.csv, events.csv, hourly.csv, detect/detect_rank*.jsonl in the same run directory), retrieved read-only by the seismicity expert.
